options.label: Authentische Employer-Branding-Reportage
options.value: Use the visual language of professional employer-branding campaign photography with authentic documentary realism.

options.label: Klar und professionell
options.value: Use the visual language of clear, professional employer-branding campaign photography with restrained corporate aesthetics.

options.label: Warm und nahbar
options.value: Use the visual language of warm, approachable editorial employer-branding photography with natural human moments.

options.label: Jung und dynamisch
options.value: Use the visual language of modern early-career campaign photography with credible energy and documentary movement.

label: Aufgabe / Kampagnenziel
help: Bleibt im Kampagnenbriefing und wird vor der Generierung in eine beobachtbare Bildaussage übersetzt.

options.label: Duales Studium sichtbar machen
options.value: Create a completely fictional recruiting image for a dual-study campaign.
options.visual_translation: Make the dual-study context visible through a concrete workplace task performed under adult guidance.

options.label: Berufseinstieg attraktiv erklären
options.value: Create a completely fictional recruiting image for an early-career campaign.
options.visual_translation: Make the career entry visible by showing the main subject independently performing a credible entry-level workplace task.

options.label: Ausbildung in Logistik zeigen
options.value: Create a completely fictional recruiting image for an apprenticeship campaign in retail logistics.
options.visual_translation: Make workplace learning visible by showing the main subject actively completing a concrete logistics process with realistic work objects and guidance.

options.label: Digitalen Fachbereich positionieren
options.value: Create a completely fictional recruiting image for an entry-level digital and administrative career campaign.
options.visual_translation: Make digital participation visible by showing the main subject solving a concrete digital or administrative workplace task.

label: Zielgruppe
help: Dient der Kampagnenbegründung und wird nicht wörtlich an die Bild-KI gesendet. Das sichtbare Alter wird ausschließlich über ‚Alterseindruck der Hauptperson‘ gesteuert.

options.label: Schulabgänger:innen in NRW
options.value: The target group consists of school graduates in North Rhine-Westphalia who are considering practical career and study options.

options.label: Interessierte am dualen Studium
options.value: The target group consists of prospective dual-study applicants who value practical learning and academic development.

options.label: Berufseinsteiger:innen
options.value: The target group consists of young adults at the beginning of their professional careers.

options.label: Quereinsteiger:innen
options.value: The target group consists of career changers looking for a structured and credible entry into retail work.

label: Unternehmens- und Branchenkontext
help: Regionale und strategische Angaben bleiben im Briefing. Die sichtbare Arbeitsumgebung wird separat unter ‚Praxiswelt / Tätigkeit‘ festgelegt.

options.label: Lebensmitteleinzelhandel in NRW
options.value: The campaign represents a modern food-retail employer in North Rhine-Westphalia without displaying a real company identity.

options.label: Handelslogistik
options.value: The campaign represents a modern retail-logistics employer without displaying a real company identity.

options.label: Verwaltung und digitale Fachbereiche
options.value: The campaign represents the administrative and digital functions of a modern retail employer without displaying a real company identity.

options.label: Filiale, Logistik und Verwaltung
options.value: The campaign represents a multi-site retail employer with store, logistics, and administrative career paths without displaying a real company identity.

label: Zentraler Arbeitgebernutzen
help: Die abstrakte Nutzenbotschaft wird in sichtbare Handlungen, Rollen und Interaktionen übersetzt.

options.label: Praxis, Verantwortung und Teamarbeit
options.value: Communicate that practical learning, early responsibility, and teamwork are central employer benefits.
options.visual_translation: Make practical learning, responsibility, and teamwork visible through active hands-on work, shared attention to the same task, and the main person performing rather than merely observing.

options.label: Entwicklung und Perspektive
options.value: Communicate structured development, credible learning opportunities, and long-term career perspectives.
options.visual_translation: Make development visible through a concrete adult learning moment in which the main person applies feedback or completes the next work step.

options.label: Digitalisierung und Mitgestaltung
options.value: Communicate digital collaboration, problem solving, and the opportunity to contribute ideas early.
options.visual_translation: Make participation visible by showing the main person using a digital work tool to solve a shared problem and contribute to the task.

options.label: Regionalität und Verlässlichkeit
options.value: Communicate regional connection, reliable collaboration, and a structured entry into working life.
options.visual_translation: Make reliability visible through an orderly everyday workflow, clear role coordination, and a credible locally familiar work environment without regional stereotypes.

label: Erkenntnis aus dem Wettbewerbsvergleich
help: Der strategische Vergleichsimpuls wird als konkrete Gestaltungsentscheidung in den Render-Prompt übertragen.

options.label: Konkrete Tätigkeit statt gestelltem Porträt
options.value: Differentiate the concept from generic posed recruiting portraits by making a concrete workplace activity immediately visible.
options.visual_translation: Prioritize a clearly observable workplace activity and task-focused interaction; avoid a posed recruiting portrait.

options.label: Belegbare Szene statt austauschbarer Aussage
options.value: Differentiate the concept from interchangeable employer claims by showing observable workplace behavior and credible work objects.
options.visual_translation: Support the campaign claim with observable workplace behavior, realistic work objects, and a causally understandable action.

options.label: Lernweg statt unklarer Karrierebotschaft
options.value: Differentiate the concept by making practical learning and the next development step visually understandable.
options.visual_translation: Make the learning path visible through adult guidance, a shared work object, and a clearly understandable next task step.

options.label: Filiale / Lebensmitteleinzelhandel
options.value: A realistic modern food-retail store during normal operations. The main person performs a clearly visible task involving shelves, products, or a tablet. The store is organized, credible, and free of readable brand names or company logos.

options.label: Logistikzentrum / Warenfluss
options.value: A realistic distribution center with organized shelves, pallets, packages, a handheld scanner, and clearly marked work zones without readable company branding. The main person checks or coordinates a visible logistics process.

options.label: Fachbereich / Verwaltung
options.value: A realistic functional department or administrative office. The main person works with a laptop, dashboard, notes, and project documents on a concrete analytical or organizational task.

options.label: Duales Studium / Praxisprojekt
options.value: A credible practical learning situation within a dual-study program. The main person combines an academic perspective with a visible workplace task and receives or contributes professional input.

options.label: Digitale Projektarbeit
options.value: A realistic digital project environment with a laptop, tablet, simple dashboard, notes, and planning material. The main person coordinates, checks, or presents a concrete project task.

label: Personenkonstellation
help: Legt Anzahl, Rollenverteilung und Bildhierarchie gemeinsam fest. Dadurch entstehen keine widersprüchlichen Einzelangaben zur Personenzahl.

options.label: Eine Hauptperson
options.value: Show exactly one clearly adult fictional foreground participant as the clear main subject.
options.negative_prompt: second foreground participant, additional foreground person

options.label: Hauptperson + Mentor:in
options.value: Show exactly two clearly adult fictional foreground participants: one clear main subject and one mentor aged approximately 35 to 50. The main subject occupies the primary visual position and actively performs the task. The mentor is secondary, positioned slightly behind or beside the main subject, and provides guidance.
options.negative_prompt: third foreground participant, extra foreground person

options.label: Hauptperson + gleichrangige Person
options.value: Show exactly two clearly adult fictional foreground participants: one clear main subject and one adult peer. The main subject remains visually primary while both contribute credibly to the same task.
options.negative_prompt: third foreground participant, extra foreground person

options.label: Dreiköpfiges Erwachsenenteam
options.value: Show exactly three clearly adult fictional foreground participants: one clear main subject and two adult colleagues with distinct functional roles in the same task. The main subject remains visually primary; no person functions as decoration.
options.negative_prompt: fourth foreground participant, extra foreground person

label: Alterseindruck der Hauptperson
help: Steuert ausschließlich den sichtbaren Alterseindruck der Hauptperson; Zielgruppenangaben verändern diesen Wert nicht.

options.label: 20–24 Jahre · Duales Studium
options.value: The main subject has the unmistakably adult appearance of a person aged approximately 20 to 24, with youthful adult facial proportions and no childlike features.
options.negative_prompt: middle-aged main subject, mature-looking main subject, main subject older than 29, underage main subject, childlike main subject

options.label: 25–29 Jahre · Berufseinstieg
options.value: The main subject has the clearly adult appearance of a person aged approximately 25 to 29.
options.negative_prompt: middle-aged main subject, main subject older than 39, underage main subject, childlike main subject

options.label: 30–39 Jahre · Berufserfahrung
options.value: The main subject has the clearly adult appearance of a person aged approximately 30 to 39.
options.negative_prompt: teenage main subject, underage main subject, elderly main subject

options.label: 40–55 Jahre · Erfahrene Fachkraft
options.value: The main subject has the clearly adult appearance of a person aged approximately 40 to 55.
options.negative_prompt: teenage main subject, underage main subject, very young main subject

label: Geschlechtspräsentation der Hauptperson
help: Optionale sichtbare Gestaltung; sie sagt nichts über Geschlechtsidentität, Kompetenz oder berufliche Rolle aus.

options.label: Feminin präsentiert
options.value: The main subject has a feminine gender presentation expressed through natural styling and overall appearance without stereotypical exaggeration.

options.label: Maskulin präsentiert
options.value: The main subject has a masculine gender presentation expressed through natural styling and overall appearance without stereotypical exaggeration.

options.label: Androgyn / geschlechtsneutral präsentiert
options.value: The main subject has an androgynous or gender-neutral presentation with natural styling and without stereotypical exaggeration.

label: Geschlechtspräsentation der Begleitperson(en)
help: Wird bei einer einzelnen Hauptperson ausgeblendet. Die Auswahl bleibt unabhängig von Hierarchie und Tätigkeit.

options.label: Feminin präsentiert
options.value: Every supporting person has a feminine gender presentation expressed through natural styling and overall appearance without stereotypical exaggeration.

options.label: Maskulin präsentiert
options.value: Every supporting person has a masculine gender presentation expressed through natural styling and overall appearance without stereotypical exaggeration.

options.label: Androgyn / geschlechtsneutral präsentiert
options.value: Every supporting person has an androgynous or gender-neutral presentation with natural styling and without stereotypical exaggeration.

label: Sichtbarer Hautton der Hauptperson
help: Steuert nur den sichtbaren Hautton. Ethnie, Nationalität, Religion und soziale Herkunft werden daraus nicht abgeleitet.

options.label: Heller Hautton
options.value: The main subject has a natural light visible skin tone.

options.label: Mittlerer Hautton
options.value: The main subject has a natural medium visible skin tone.

options.label: Dunkler Hautton
options.value: The main subject has a natural dark visible skin tone.

options.value: Every supporting person has a natural light visible skin tone.

options.label: Mittlerer Hautton
options.value: Every supporting person has a natural medium visible skin tone.

options.value: Every supporting person has a natural dark visible skin tone.

help: Optionale sichtbare Haarstruktur ohne kulturelle oder charakterliche Zuschreibung.

options.value: The main subject has naturally straight hair.

options.label: Gewelltes Haar
options.value: The main subject has naturally wavy hair.

help: Wird bei einer einzelnen Hauptperson ausgeblendet; die Auswahl bleibt eine rein sichtbare Gestaltungsangabe.

options.label: Glattes Haar
options.value: Every supporting person has naturally straight hair.

options.label: Gewelltes Haar
options.value: Every supporting person has naturally wavy hair.

options.label: Lockiges Haar
options.value: Every supporting person has naturally curly hair.

label: Hintergrundpersonen
help: Die Vordergrundkonstellation bleibt unverändert; dieses Feld regelt ausschließlich zusätzliche Personen im Hintergrund.

options.label: Keine Hintergrundpersonen
options.value: No additional people are visible in the background; the selected foreground participants are the only people in the entire image.
options.negative_prompt: background person, background customer, background worker, crowd, bystander

options.label: Höchstens zwei erwachsene Mitarbeitende
options.value: At most one or two clearly adult fictional staff members may appear unobtrusively in the distant background. They must look unmistakably adult and perform a plausible work task without competing with the main subject.

options.label: Höchstens zwei erwachsene Kund:innen
options.value: At most one or two clearly adult fictional customers may appear unobtrusively in the distant background. They must look unmistakably adult and must not compete with the main subject.

label: Arbeitsweise / Zusammenarbeit
help: Die Oberfläche bietet nur Tätigkeiten an, die zur gewählten Personenkonstellation passen.

options.label: Konzentriert an einer Aufgabe
options.value: The main person is focused on one clearly visible and plausible task. Hands, gaze, and relevant work objects align naturally with the activity.

options.label: Austausch mit einer Person
options.value: The main person exchanges information with one clearly adult fictional colleague while both focus on the same document, screen, product, tool, or work object.

options.label: Praktische Anleitung
options.value: A concrete learning moment is visible: the main subject actively performs a work step while the adult mentor provides guidance. Both focus on the same object, process, or document.

options.label: Team bespricht eine Aufgabe
options.value: The three-person adult team briefly discusses one concrete task around a shared table, screen, plan, product display, or work area. Every person has a clear functional connection to the task.

options.label: Ergebnis prüfen oder übergeben
options.value: The main person checks or hands over a visible work result, document, product arrangement, package, plan, or project result while all other participants remain connected to the same task.

options.label: Natürlich freundlich
options.value: a natural slight smile, relaxed eyes, and credible facial detail

options.label: Ruhig selbstsicher
options.value: a calm confident expression with steady eyes and a relaxed mouth

options.label: Konzentriert
options.value: a focused expression directed toward the visible task

options.label: Motiviert
options.value: an alert and engaged expression with natural positive energy

options.label: Offen und einladend
options.value: an open approachable expression with relaxed cheeks and authentic warmth

label: Kleidung der Hauptperson
help: Kleidungsart und Farbpalette werden gemeinsam festgelegt, damit keine zufällige Einheitskleidung entsteht.

options.label: Hellblaues Overshirt · Weiß · Dunkelblau
options.value: The main subject wears a light-blue overshirt over a plain white top, dark navy trousers, and practical understated shoes. The clothing contains no logo, slogan, name tag, or green garment.
options.negative_prompt: green shirt on main subject, green overshirt on main subject

options.label: Dunkelblaue Jacke · Hellgrau · Anthrazit
options.value: The main subject wears a plain dark-navy work jacket over a light-grey top, charcoal trousers, and practical understated shoes. The clothing contains no logo, slogan, name tag, or green garment.
options.negative_prompt: green shirt on main subject, green jacket on main subject

options.label: Sandfarbenes Overshirt · Weiß · Schwarz
options.value: The main subject wears a plain sand-colored overshirt over a white top, black trousers, and practical understated shoes. The clothing contains no logo, slogan, name tag, or green garment.
options.negative_prompt: green shirt on main subject, green overshirt on main subject

options.label: Business Casual · Blau · Grau
options.value: The main subject wears a plain light-blue shirt or blouse with well-fitted grey trousers and practical understated shoes. The clothing contains no logo, slogan, name tag, or green garment.
options.negative_prompt: green shirt on main subject, green blouse on main subject

label: Kleidung der Begleitpersonen
help: Wird bei einer einzelnen Hauptperson automatisch ausgeblendet. Begleitpersonen erhalten sichtbar andere Farben und Kleidungsformen.

options.label: Helle neutrale Kontrastkleidung
options.value: Every supporting person wears an individually distinct outfit using light grey, beige, and charcoal garments. Garment combinations differ clearly from the main subject and from one another. No matching uniform, identical shirt, or green garment is used.
options.negative_prompt: matching outfits, identical shirts, matching green shirts, green shirt on supporting person

options.label: Dunkelblau-graue Kontrastkleidung

options.negative_prompt: matching outfits, identical shirts, matching green shirts, green shirt on supporting person

options.label: Sandfarben-graue Kontrastkleidung
options.value: Every supporting person wears an individually distinct outfit using sand, light grey, and charcoal garments. Garment combinations differ clearly from the main subject and from one another. No matching uniform, identical shirt, or green garment is used.
options.negative_prompt: matching outfits, identical shirts, matching green shirts, green shirt on supporting person
